raw.details:
Line Follower Race

About the Competition

Line Follower Race is a robotics competition in which teams operate a fully autonomous robot designed to follow a designated track using onboard sensors. Teams will be evaluated on speed, accuracy, path-following performance, and successful completion of the track.

The competition will be conducted as a direct offline final event, with technical inspection and race attempts conducted during the event.

Eligibility

  • Open to undergraduate and diploma engineering students.

  • Participants may belong to any college or university.

  • Each team must consist of 1–3 members.

  • All team members must satisfy the eligibility requirements.

  • There is no registration fee.

Team Size

Minimum: 1 member
Maximum: 3 members

Format

The competition will be conducted as a direct offline final event.

Technical Inspection

Before the race attempt, each robot will be inspected by the technical team.

The inspection may include:

  • Length: Maximum 25 cm

  • Width: Maximum 25 cm

  • Height: Maximum 25 cm

  • Verification that the robot is fully autonomous.

  • Verification of onboard sensors and navigation system.

  • General safety and construction check.

  • Verification that the robot complies with the competition rules.

Only robots that pass the inspection will be permitted to participate.

Race

  • Each team will receive a designated race attempt according to the event schedule.

  • The robot must complete the designated line-following track autonomously.

  • Manual intervention is not permitted except at officially designated checkpoints.

  • If a restart is permitted at a checkpoint, the applicable time penalty will be added to the team's recorded time.

  • The completion time and penalties will be recorded for ranking.

Robot Specifications

Maximum Dimensions

The robot must not exceed:

Specification Maximum Limit
Length 25 cm
Width 25 cm
Height 25 cm

The robot may be measured by the technical team before its race attempt.

Autonomous Operation

  • The robot must operate fully autonomously during the race.

  • Navigation must rely solely on the robot's onboard sensors and control system.

  • No remote control, wireless steering, manual guidance, or external navigation assistance is permitted during the run.

  • The robot must be capable of following the track without continuous human intervention.

Rules & Regulations

  1. Each team must use one robot for the competition.

  2. The robot must be fully autonomous.

  3. The robot must navigate using only its onboard sensors and control system.

  4. The maximum robot dimensions are 25 × 25 × 25 cm.

  5. The robot will be inspected before its race attempt.

  6. Any modification made after inspection may require re-inspection and approval from the technical team.

  7. Manual intervention is prohibited during the race except at designated checkpoints, where a restart may be permitted.

  8. Any permitted manual restart at a checkpoint will carry the applicable time penalty.

  9. Physical contact with the track boundaries beyond the tolerance specified by the organizers may result in a penalty or disqualification for that attempt.

  10. Teams must use their registered robot throughout the competition.

  11. Swapping robots between team members or using another team's robot is not permitted.

  12. Teams must not tamper with, alter, obstruct, or intentionally damage the track.

  13. Participants must follow all instructions given by the organizers and technical officials.

  14. The organizing committee reserves the right to stop a run if the robot or its operation creates a safety risk.

Race Procedure

  1. Teams report to the designated staging area at their allotted time.

  2. The robot undergoes technical inspection.

  3. The technical team verifies the robot's dimensions and autonomous operation.

  4. The approved robot is taken to the starting position.

  5. The race begins when instructed by the official.

  6. The robot follows the track autonomously.

  7. Any permitted checkpoint restart is recorded along with the applicable penalty.

  8. Track completion time and penalties are recorded.

  9. The final ranking is determined from the recorded performance.

Judging Criteria

Teams will be evaluated based on:

  • Track Completion Time

  • Checkpoint Penalties

  • Accuracy of Path-Following

  • Successful Track Completion

  • Compliance with Competition Rules

The exact penalty values and track-boundary tolerance will be announced during the event briefing.

Grounds for Disqualification

A team may be disqualified for:

  • Exceeding the permitted 25 × 25 × 25 cm size limit.

  • Using a robot that is not fully autonomous.

  • Manual intervention outside designated checkpoints.

  • Using remote control or external navigation assistance.

  • Swapping or replacing the registered robot without authorization.

  • Tampering with or intentionally modifying the track.

  • Interfering with another team's robot or equipment.

  • Deliberately violating technical or safety instructions.

  • Unsportsmanlike, abusive, or disruptive conduct.

  • Any other action that compromises the fairness or safety of the competition.

Safety & Conduct

  • Participants must handle their robots and electrical components responsibly.

  • Teams must follow instructions from organizers and technical officials.

  • Participants must not enter restricted areas of the track without permission.

  • Any robot considered unsafe may be stopped or removed from the competition.

  • Professional and respectful conduct is expected throughout the event.

Results & Judging

  • Rankings will be based on track completion time, applicable penalties, and path-following performance.

  • In case of a tie, the organizers may conduct an additional run or use a predetermined tie-breaker.

  • The judges' and technical officials' decisions will be final and binding, subject to correction of any administrative or calculation error.

Registration

Registration Fee: Free
Eligibility: Undergraduate and Diploma Engineering Students
Team Size: 1–3 Members
Format: Direct Offline Final Competition
Robot Size: Maximum 25 × 25 × 25 cm
Operation: Fully Autonomous
Category: Technology / Robotics
